# Adbibe

> Founder-led AI performance marketing agency based in Bangalore, India.

Adbibe is a founder-led AI performance marketing agency based in Bangalore, India, specializing in paid acquisition, programmatic advertising, CRO, marketing automation, and brand strategy for D2C and SaaS brands.

Adbibe helps D2C, SaaS, and growth-stage brands scale paid acquisition,
improve conversion rates, and manage programmatic media — with founder-led
execution and no account-manager layers.

## Services
- Performance marketing with AI (Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn, Snapchat, Bing)
- Programmatic advertising (DV360, DSPs, CTV, Display)
- AI automation & AI marketing (n8n, Make, AI agents, DCO)
- Social media marketing (Instagram, LinkedIn, X, Facebook)
- Brand strategy (positioning, identity, GTM)
- Marketing consulting (CMO-as-a-Service, audits, training)
- Conversion rate optimization (CRO)
- Analytics & attribution

## Case studies
- Toyota — programmatic reporting & viewability (DV360, Xandr)
- Wonderla — 120+ programmatic campaign launches
- 8 Network — CPI reduced from ₹80–100 to ₹4–9
- WeSkill — 55% CPL reduction via full-funnel Meta/Google
- Amama — ROAS improved from 1.2x to 4–5x

## Founder
